visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain views, including the 1024×640 summary. The individual exterior retains the oblique high nave/polygonal choir, irregular lower chapel envelope, attached south range, round conical stair turret, flying buttresses, rectangular tower-porch portal, small clock/oculus, triple middle lights, paired louvered belfry lights and two-stage slate bulb roof with an open little lantern. Raised the choir-window sill clear of the low roof, recessed louver slats and added the missing south-range window rhythm. Fine figures and tracery are simplified.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic views. Five existing shared 256-square ashlar, sandstone, slate, wood and painted-metal graphs serve six groups including local blue-grey glass. Metric UVs, linear tints and flat architectural normals; no embedded images, facade photographs, baked lighting or bespoke textures. Shared graphs read once and unload leaves zero live model geometries. Geographic review uses flat terrain; portable review retains the standard viewer DEM.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late, street/block/skyline, texture-free silhouette, six details, four matched whole levels and four transitions. Skyline 581 triangles retains the oblique church, lower chapel/south-range envelope, stair turret, porch tower, layered bulb and open lantern. District 3041 adds shared surfaces, clerestory/choir recesses, triple/paired tower lights, blind arches, clock and flying buttresses. Street 7812 adds chapel/range windows, mullions, recessed slats and buttress finials; close-up/master 8957 retain sparse portal sculpture abstractions. Cotswold cottages are synthetic style fixtures, not Sarlat streets. Physical phone/laptop timing remains pending.

geographicReview.notes: Retained exact way/376197270 and Q2942447 identify Cathédrale Saint-Sacerdos. Current standard viewer PMTiles whole 35184748286102 and roof part 35185096439581 plus two small unlabeled touching north projections provide 130 raw outline points. The small projections are interpreted as exterior buttress feet, not independently identified buildings. Preserve the original anchor and heading -0.322408167209 rad. The high nave follows its oblique mapped roof within this native frame: longitudinal positive toward the northeast choir, negative toward the southwest tower-porch. Do not rotate the nave to native X or relocate it to the older reference POI. Separate neighboring town houses and the Lanterne des Morts remain host content. No height, level or roof-height tags and no independent dimension facts. All heights are picture estimates above floor 0.5 m: low aisles and radiating chapels 10.5 m eaves / 13.5 m upper joins; high nave and polygonal choir 21 m eaves / 26 m ridge. Tower square body 30 m, flared lower slate cap 36.2 m, pinched upper bulb 44.3 m, open lantern 47.5 m, little cap 49.6 m and weather vane 51 m. Stair turret 23 m wall / 26.7 m cone. Internal component divisions, openings, flying buttresses, roof profiles, clock and simplified sculpture are estimates rather than measured architectural plans. Standard viewer DEM datum 148.174833 m; selected raw perimeter -0.82 to 1.31 m. Floor 0.5 m; adaptive footings cross Y=0 and extend below retained samples. No terrain cutout or flattening. Exact parvis, steps, east terrace, door/base joins, absolute altitude and walking remain unverified. All 72 current viewer-footprint checks cover four selected controls and preserve five nearby host buildings plus west-street, east-open-ground and south-open-ground regions. The two small unlabeled touching north projections are interpreted as buttress feet and explicitly modeled; this role is an estimate. No road replacement or ground cutout. Native heading and anchor are retained without horizontal rescale; approximately 3° facing uncertainty. Exact host-ground joins remain unverified.

Four whole/roof/small-projection controls retain 130 raw points/properties, plus earlier whole/tags. All heights and detailed component divisions are estimates. Fine sculpture, tracery, inscriptions, interiors/bells, concealed roof joins, current finish, engineering and exact terrace/threshold/base contact are simplified, excluded or unverified.
